description: Whisper transcription of an uploaded file — 1 credit/min; noSpeech=true and 0 credits when there is no speech. Costs 1 credit/min. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

file.description: Video or audio file (multipart form field — use -F file=@path, not a query string). Max 200MB / 60 minutes.

language.description: ISO-639-1 Whisper language hint, e.g. "en" or "tr". Omit to auto-detect.

timestampGranularity.description: segment (default) or word — word-level timings when Whisper exposes them.

translate.description: When true, translate speech to English (Whisper translations API). Default false.

name: video_transcript
title: Video File Transcript
